package: "openpipeline_spatial"
version: "v0.7.0"
title: "spaceranger_hd_mapping"
subtitle: "openpipeline_spatial v0.7.0"
toc: true
namespace: "Workflows/ingestion"
description: "Take raw Visium HD FASTQ files and produce a SpatialData object with the segmented cells. Runs Space Ranger 4.1.0 to align reads and perform nucleus/cell segmentation, then converts the segmented output to SpatialData."
type: "workflow"
latest: "true"
---

::: {.ref-description}
Segmentation runs by default when an H&E microscope image (`--image`) is
provided. Provide `--probe_set` for probe-based Visium HD assays.
:::

`string` [required]{.arg-required}

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The fastq.gz files to align with Space Ranger. Can also be a single
directory containing fastq.gz files.

Individual FASTQ files should follow the naming convention of 10x Genomics:
[Sample Name]_S[Sample Number]_L[Lane Number]_[Read Type]_001.fastq.gz
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"sample_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz"`, `"sample_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--gex_reference`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Path of folder containing 10x-compatible reference.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"/path/to/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--probe_set`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
CSV file specifying the probe set used. Omit for Visium HD 3' data
(sequencing-based); provide it only for probe-based Visium HD.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"Visium_Mouse_Transcriptome_Probe_Set_v2.0_mm10-2020-A.csv"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--cytaimage`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Brightfield image generated by the CytAssist instrument. Required for
Visium HD.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"cytassist.tiff"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--image`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
H&E microscope image (TIFF or JPG). Required to run nucleus/cell
segmentation.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name

Description

Attributes

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_raw`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Location where the raw Space Ranger output folder will be stored.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"output_dir"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_spatialdata`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The Space Ranger output, converted to SpatialData (Zarr).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"output.zarr"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--mode`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Which Space Ranger HD output to convert to SpatialData: `segmented_cells`
(per-cell counts and cell boundary polygons) or `bins` (binned counts at
`--bin_size`). Segmentation is generally preferred, but binned output is
available for compatibility.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"segmented_cells"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"segmented_cells"`, `"bins"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--bin_size`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Bin size in microns to convert when `--mode bins`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `8`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `2`, `8`, `16`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_type`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Which count matrix to convert (`filtered` or `raw`). Applies to both modes.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"filtered"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"filtered"`, `"raw"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_layer`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
If provided, store the counts as a named layer in addition to `.X`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--dataset_id`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Identifier used to name the spatial elements. Defaults to the sample id.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`

`--r2_length`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Hard trim the input Read 2 to this length before analysis

`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--filter_probes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to filter the probe set using the "included" column
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--custom_bin_size`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Bin Visium HD data to an additional custom size in microns (4-100, even).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `4`

[Max]{.arg-key} `100`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--include_introns`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Include intronic reads in the count. When unset, Space Ranger applies its own default
(true for Visium HD 3' and Visium v1, false otherwise).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--nucleus_segmentation`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Enable or disable nucleus/cell segmentation (on by default when an H&E image is given).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--cell_annotation_model`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Cloud-based cell type annotation model to use, which requires
`--tenx_cloud_token_path`. When left out, Space Ranger still annotates
human samples with the bundled Pan-Human Azimuth model, which runs
locally and needs no token.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"auto"`, `"human_pca_v1_beta"`, `"mouse_pca_v1_beta"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--tenx_cloud_token_path`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Path to a 10x Cloud token JSON, required for cloud-based annotation models.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--disable_cell_annotation`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Disable cell type annotation.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::

### Segmentation Options

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::

Description

Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--custom_segmentation_file`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Custom nucleus segmentation mask to use instead of the built-in algorithm.
Requires --nucleus_expansion_distance_micron.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"nucleus_segmentation.geojson"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--nucleus_expansion_distance_micron`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Distance in microns to expand each nucleus to approximate the cell boundary.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--max_nucleus_diameter_px`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Maximum nucleus diameter in pixels, for samples with exceptionally large cells.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--umi_registration`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Enable or disable UMI-based registration that aligns the microscope image to the UMI
count data for Visium HD. When unset, Space Ranger applies its default.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--umi_to_image_offset`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Supply a custom offset (as accepted by Space Ranger) to override UMI-to-image
registration when automatic convergence is incorrect.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/ingestion/spaceranger_hd_mapping/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.7.0/components/workflows/ingestion/spaceranger_hd_mapping);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/ingestion/spaceranger_hd_mapping/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
